'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[2024 Syrian opposition offensives]]
***[[Battle of Aleppo (2024)|Battle of Aleppo]]
****Pro-government forces close [[Aleppo International Airport]] and major roads in [[Aleppo]], [[Syria]], as rebels continue to advance into the city. The airport is later captured by the rebels. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2024/11/30/syrian-rebels-capture-aleppo-airport-seize-majority-city/ (''The Telegraph'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/aleppo-airport-closed-sources-say-syrian-rebels-reach-heart-city-2024-11-29/ (Reuters)]
****Rebels capture the [[Citadel of Aleppo]] and the [[University of Aleppo]] as they continue to advance through the city. [https://www.newarab.com/news/syrian-rebels-reach-aleppo-citadel-impose-curfew-after-assault (New Arab)]
****Rebel tanks reach the main [[Saadallah al-Jabiri Square]] in Aleppo's city centre with the [[Syrian Observatory for Human Rights]] reporting that a majority of the city is now under the control of rebel forces. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cly27r5p0yno (BBC News)]
****The [[Syrian Army]] announces a total withdrawal from Aleppo, formally acknowledging the fall of the city to rebel forces, and saying that its troops will regroup and launch a [[Counterattack|counter-offensive]] to retake the city. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syrias-military-announces-aleppo-troop-withdrawal-prepare-counteroffensive-2024-11-30/ (Reuters)]
****A [[Russian Air Force|Russian]] [[airstrike]] hits a busy roundabout in Aleppo, killing at least 16 people and injuring 20 others, the first time that Russian warplanes have targeted the city since 2016. [https://www.syriahr.com/%d8%a7%d8%b3%d8%aa%d8%b4%d9%87%d8%a7%d8%af-16-%d8%b4%d8%ae%d8%b5-%d9%85%d8%ac%d8%b2%d8%b1%d8%a9-%d9%85%d8%b1%d9%88%d8%b9%d8%a9-%d8%aa%d8%b1%d8%aa%d9%83%d8%a8%d9%87%d8%a7-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%b7%d8%a7/738431/ (SOHR)]
***[[Operation Dawn of Freedom]]
****The [[Turkey|Turkish]]-backed [[Syrian National Army]] launches an offensive in northern [[Aleppo Governorate]], capturing the town of [[Tadef]]. [https://caliber.az/en/post/escalating-conflict-in-northern-aleppo-pro-turkish-factions-launch-offensive-as-syrian-army-tightens-control (Caliber)]
***A [[Syrian Salvation Government|Syrian rebel coalition]] declares full control of [[Idlib Governorate]] after capturing the towns of [[Maarat al-Numan]] and [[Khan Shaykhun]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2024/11/30/syrian-opposition-forces-say-all-of-idlib-province-under-opposition (Al Arabiya)]
***Rebel forces led by [[Tahrir al-Sham]] capture the [[Abu al-Duhur Air Base]] in Idlib Governorate following the withdrawal of the [[Syrian Armed Forces]]. [https://www.skynewsarabia.com/middle-east/1758750-%D8%B3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A7-%D9%85%D8%B7%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%B9%D8%B3%D9%83%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D9%85%D9%87%D9%85-%D9%8A%D8%B3%D9%82%D8%B7-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%94%D9%8A%D8%AF%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%81%D8%B5%D8%A7%D9%8A%D9%94%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%AD%D8%A9 (Sky News Arabia)] [https://caliber.az/en/post/syrian-rebels-seize-abu-al-duhur-airbase-amid-intensified-battles (Caliber)]
***The [[Kurds in Syria|Kurdish]]-led [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] (SDF) take control of the [[Shia Islam|Shiite]]-majority towns of [[Nubbul]] and [[Al-Zahraa]] in Aleppo Governorate after [[Syrian government]] forces withdraw from the towns. [https://www.kurdistan24.net/en/story/813074/sdf-controls-two-towns-near-aleppo-says-sohr (Kurdistan 24)]
***Rebel forces capture the towns of [[Morek]], [[Kafr Zita]], [[Qalaat al-Madiq]], and [[Al-Lataminah]] in [[Hama Governorate]]. [https://www.lbcgroup.tv/news/middleeastnews/820690/syrian-opposition-forces-gain-ground-in-morek-ltamenah-and-kafr-zita-i/en (Lbc)]
***Rebel forces advance within {{conv|20|km}} of the regional capital [[Hama]] with heavy clashes underway on the [[M5 Motorway (Syria)|M5 Motorway]]. Pro-government forces reportedly retreat from the city and [[Hama Air Base]] toward [[Homs Governorate]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/armed-anti-regime-groups-advance-towards-hama-province-in-syria/3409645 (Anadolu Ajansi)] [https://www.syriahr.com/%d9%88%d8%b3%d8%b7-%d8%a7%d9%86%d8%b3%d8%ad%d8%a7%d8%a8-%d9%84%d9%82%d9%88%d8%a7%d8%aa-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%86%d8%b8%d8%a7%d9%85-%d9%85%d9%86-%d9%85%d8%af%d9%8a%d9%86%d8%a9-%d8%ad%d9%85%d8%a7%d8%a9-%d9%88/738472/ (SOHR)]
***SDF forces clash with the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army near [[Tell Abyad]], [[Raqqa Governorate]] and in [[Manbij District]], Aleppo Governorate, as pro-government forces withdraw from the region, leaving a [[power vacuum]]. [https://www.syriahr.com/en/350030/ (SOHR)]
***Local forces in [[Talbiseh]], northern [[Homs Governorate]], attack [[Syrian Army]] convoys withdrawing towards [[Homs]], seizing control of the town's checkpoint and burning it following pro-government forces withdrawal. [https://www.syriahr.com/%d8%b9%d9%84%d9%89-%d8%ae%d9%84%d9%81%d9%8a%d8%a9-%d9%85%d9%87%d9%80-%d9%80%d8%a7%d8%ac%d9%80-%d9%80%d9%85%d9%80-%d9%80%d8%a9-%d9%86%d8%a7%d8%ad%d9%8a%d8%a9-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%85%d8%af%d9%8a%d9%86%d8%a9/738482/ (SOHR)]
**[[Southern Syria offensive (2024)|Southern Syria offensive]]
***South [[List of armed factions in the Syrian Civil War|Syrian rebel groups]] announce a new offensive on [[Daraa Governorate]] and [[Suwayda Governorate]] with the goal of implementing a [[pincer movement]] on [[Damascus]]. [https://www.alaraby.co.uk/politics/%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%B4%D9%8A%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%AF%D8%B1%D8%B9%D8%A7-%D8%AC%D9%86%D9%88%D8%A8%D9%8A%D9%91-%D8%B3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%AA%D8%A3%D9%8A%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B3%D8%B9-%D9%84%D8%B9%D9%85%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%B1%D8%AF%D8%B9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B9%D8%AF%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%86 (Al-Araby)]
*[[Arab–Israeli conflict]]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Gaza war hostage crisis]]
****[[Hamas]] releases a propaganda video showing [[Israeli Americans|Israeli American]] hostage Edan Alexander. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/hamas-propaganda-video-israeli-american-hostage-edan-alexander/ (CBS News)]
***An [[Israel]]i airstrike on a car in the [[Gaza Strip]] kills five people, including employees of [[World Central Kitchen]]. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-lebanon-hezbollah-iran-news-11-30-2024-506c8f976ad62afcf2a0ec977a8b6451 (AP)]
**[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
***Two people are killed and six others are injured in three [[airstrike]]s by [[Israel]] in southern [[Lebanon]] that occurred despite the [[2024 Israel–Lebanon ceasefire agreement|ceasefire]] with [[Hezbollah]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/30/israeli-attacks-kill-and-wound-several-in-southern-lebanon-despite-ceasefire (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**The [[Rapid Support Forces]] announce a civil administration formed by a prime minister and a 90-member legislative council. [https://www.dabangasudan.org/en/all-news/article/sudan-war-rsf-set-up-civilian-administration-in-khartoum-state (Dabanga Sudan)] [https://theconversation.com/how-militia-groups-capture-states-and-ruin-countries-the-case-of-sudans-rapid-support-forces-234650 (The Conversation)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**At least nine people are killed and four others are injured after an attack in a commercial zone in [[Apaseo el Grande]], [[Guanajuato]], [[Mexico]]. Local authorities say the attack relates to the drug sales in the region. [https://lasillarota.com/guanajuato/estado/2024/12/2/investigan-venta-de-drogas-como-causa-de-la-matanza-del-trebol-en-apaseo-el-alto-512588.html (''La Silla Rota'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Vietnam]] approves a US[[United States dollar|$]]67 billion {{conv|1541|km}} [[high speed rail]] line from [[Hanoi]] to [[Ho Chi Minh City]], which will be an updated version of the [[North–South express railway]] proposal. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/vietnam-approves-data-electricity-laws-67-bln-rail-plan-2024-11-30/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 27 people are killed and more than 100 others are missing when a boat capsizes in the [[Niger River]] in [[Kogi State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/30/several-dead-after-boat-capsizes-in-nigeria (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Ibar-Lepenac attack]]
**[[Kosovo Police|Police]] arrest eight people linked to an explosion on a [[canal]] near [[Zubin Potok]], [[Mitrovica District]], [[Kosovo]], that supplies water to the country's two main [[Electrical energy in Kosovo|power plants]]. The [[Kosovar government]] blames [[Serbia]] for the "terrorist" acts, which Serbia denies. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/30/kosovo-pm-blames-serbia-for-explosion-at-canal-supplying-power-plants (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2024/11/30/kosovo-blames-serbia-for-explosion-that-cut-water-and-power-supplies (Euronews)] [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2024/11/30/explosion-at-kosovo-canal-feeding-key-power-plants-labeled-a-terrorist-attack-by-pm_6734656_4.html (''Le Monde'')]
*[[San Andrés Preparatory School attack]]
**A student attacks his classmates with a hammer and injures two before being subdued by other students at a high school in [[Guadalajara]], [[Jalisco]], [[México]]. The attack was streamed on [[Twitter|X]], where the perpetrator published [[Nazi]] views and other violent content. [https://www.debate.com.mx/guadalajara/Joven-que-ataco-a-sus-companeros-en-preparatoria-de-Guadalajara-anuncio-previamente-agresion-20241130-0144.html (''El Debate'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Georgian post-election protests]]
**More than 100 demonstrators are arrested in [[Tbilisi]], [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]], while protesting against [[Prime Minister of Georgia|Prime Minister]] [[Irakli Kobakhidze]]'s decision to temporarily suspend the country's [[Accession of Georgia to the European Union|accession plans to the European Union]] to 2028. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/100-arrested-georgian-police-clash-protesters-suspension-eu-116332873 (ABC News)]
*[[2024 Icelandic parliamentary election]]
**Citizens of [[Iceland]] vote in a [[snap election]] to elect the 63 members of the [[Althing]] [[national parliament]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/30/iceland-holds-parliamentary-election-after-governments-collapse (Al Jazeera)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2024 Copa Libertadores]]
**In [[association football]], [[Botafogo de Futebol e Regatas|Botafogo]] win their first [[Copa Libertadores]] title after defeating [[Clube Atlético Mineiro|Atlético Mineiro]] 3–1 in an all-[[Football in Brazil|Brazil]]ian [[2024 Copa Libertadores final|final]] at the [[Estadio Monumental (Buenos Aires)|Estadio Monumental]] in [[Buenos Aires]], [[Argentina]]. [https://apnews.com/article/copa-libertadores-final-botafogo-mineiro-dbe253cb384372888fc049d97b0ac8cb (AP)]
